text:
maria (partnerships): Quick heads-up: OxideCompute is asking for a short perf/W sweep tomorrow 10:00am PT. Objective: establish a normalized watt-per-token baseline for their SoC and validate our kernel micro-tweaks. Partner will join the call. Can bench + runtime + kernel coordinate minimal artifact sharing (aggregated only)? Link to prep doc: https://go/redwood/oxide-soc-sweep :mag:

ajay (bench-ops): I'll book the rack and PDU and attach the power meter. Budgeting 90m slot. Want to run two configs: `stock-kernel` and `patched-kernel-v1` with identical workload. Who owns the patched kernel?

sam (eng-ml-runtime): Kernel patch is from our runtime repo (nora's team), it's a small spinlock optimization + tuned memcpy. We'll test with both FP16 and int8 paths. Also want to exercise the caching path (prefix cache warm run).

nora (kernel-team): Confirm I own the patch. We can't share raw kallsyms or host traces with the partner under the NDA. Proposal: we provide a zipped aggregated report: `metrics_summary.csv`, `top_hotspots.tsv` (symbol-less ids), and `power_summary.csv`. Does that meet partner needs?

oxidecompute-eng: That sounds good. We can provide wall-power traces at 200ms granularity and SoC telemetry (freq, package_temp). We need the CSV header names to match our parser: `ts_ms,power_w,soc_freq_mhz,board_temp_c`. Also, can you include a `run_id` in outputs so we can align sets?

ajay (bench-ops): Good call on run_id. I'll make bench-bot append `run_id` to all artifacts and upload to s3://redwood-partner-exchange/oxide/sweeps/ (partner read-only).

sam (eng-ml-runtime): Proposed smoke command (two runs per kernel):

```
./bench_runner --model=opt-350m --seq=2048 --batch=4 \
  --runs=2 --warmup=1 \
  --kernel=patched-kernel-v1 \
  --export-power=power_run_<run_id>.csv \
  --export-agg=metrics_summary_<run_id>.csv \
  --limit-watts=180
```

Keep `--limit-watts` so we can compare perf at a fixed power cap.

nora (kernel-team): For perf counters we can export aggregated counters per 10s interval: `L2_MISS,L1_HIT,ipc,branch_mispred`. Is that enough? We won't export raw perf.data.

oxidecompute-eng: Those counters look OK. Please also include `gpu_idle_pct` so we can compute utilization-adjusted watt. We will map fields on our side.

ajay (bench-ops): I'll add `--export-counters=counters_<run_id>.csv` to the command. Bench-bot will run local validation first (quick 2min smoke) then full 40m sweep.

maria (partnerships): Privacy reminder: remove hostnames, IPs and any golden-images IDs from artifacts. Only aggregate metrics, no symbol maps. We'll include a short joint statement draft if numbers look good, but that's TBD.

bench-bot: Pre-checks done. Rack-21 reserved. Power meter confirmed. Upload bucket: s3://redwood-partner-exchange/oxide/sweeps/. Will tag artifacts with `run_id=oxide-2026-03-25-1` when started. :robot_face:

sam (eng-ml-runtime): One more ask: include the raw command line used (redacted hostnames) in a `metadata.txt` so experiments are reproducible. Nothing with creds.

nora (kernel-team): Agreed. I'll also attach an ABI note: `kernel-version`, `gcc-build-id` (no host metadata). That should help the partner triage regressions without revealing infra details.

ajay (bench-ops): Zoom + recording for the session: https://zoom.redwood.com/oxide-sweep. I'll be oncall 9:45-11:30 PT.

maria (partnerships): Action items:
- ajay: run booking, bench-bot orchestration, S3 upload + run_id
- nora: push telemetry contract & ABI note to GH (no symbols)
- sam: add `--limit-watts` and counter exports to runbook + sample command
- oxidecompute-eng: confirm CSV headers and read-only S3 access

Reconvene in channel after the sweep (~11:30 PT) for an initial readout and to decide if we need a deeper kernel trace session. Thanks all. :v:
